title: The lane lint passes the lane's PR body to ci-job, so an excuse in the PR body reads as it does in CI
why: `merge --lane-lint` runs bin/ci-job without the lane's PR body, and ci-job maps `${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}` to "". So an excuse that lives only in the PR body (Drops-lines, Retire-run) reads FAIL before CI, even when CI would pass (lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run, session_013NEJL4TDRWqka4aSU2Bv7L, 04:06 CST Nov 8; coordinator 04:07 CST).
note: Fix: the lane lint reads the lane's PR body and passes it as ci-job's PR_BODY value. Red case first: a lane whose Retire-run line is only in its PR body FAILs the lane lint today; control: with no PR the lane lint behaves as today. Owner: lane session_013NEJL4TDRWqka4aSU2Bv7L, a follow-up from #1712's head with Merge after: #1712, after step pre-existing-needs-main-run; the lane reports doing when it starts. Related: steps silent-undo-ci-body and silent-undo-checks-pr-base. Queue fix (coordinator, 04:07 CST Nov 8). Filed 04:08 CST Nov 8. Doing (lane, 04:10 CST Nov 8): red tests started on branch lane-lint-reads-pr-body from 5e95ca9b5; its PR merges after pre-existing-needs-main-run.
